name: Validating case CS-0000280 assignment.
description: Validating case CS-0000280 assignment to William Wyatt (group with lower active cases) and Proactive Case Management (active group).

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case cc
JOIN user u ON cc.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON cc.assignment_group_id = g.group_id
WHERE cc.number = 'CS-0000280'
  AND u.first_name = 'William'
  AND u.last_name = 'Wyatt'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring';

name: Validating William Wyatt's group membership.
description: Validating whether William Wyatt is a member of Proactive Case Monitoring group.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user_group_member ugm
JOIN user u ON ugm.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_group g ON ugm.group_id = g.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'William'
  AND u.last_name = 'Wyatt'
  AND g.name = 'Proactive Case Monitoring';

name: Validating remind notification.
description: Validating whether a successful reminder notification has been sent to the customer of case CS-0000280.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN customer_case cc ON n.case_id = cc.case_id
JOIN contact c ON cc.contact_id = c.contact_id
JOIN user u ON c.portal_user_id = u.user_id
WHERE cc.number = 'CS-0000280'
  AND n.email = u.email
  AND n.type = 'reminder'
  AND n.status = 'success';
